---
id: bottlenose-dolphin
title: Bottlenose dolphin
---
The common bottlenose dolphin (*Tursiops truncatus*) is a toothed whale
of coastal and offshore waters. Phonic lips in the nasal complex produce
broadband clicks; a fatty melon focuses them. Returning echoes are
received through the lower jaw and coded as range and texture (aquatic
biosonar). Signature whistles label individuals. Fission-fusion groups
take fish cooperatively.
